name: shadow-weasel
method: continuous source-textured triangular mesh, anatomical local weighted controls; no separate cutout layers
sourcePreparation: First rendered approved idle frame restored uniformly to its original 512px virtual canvas; no per-frame fitting.
timelineInterpolation: smoothstep per interval; angles in degrees and translations in fixed source pixel coordinates
action: lower the shoulders, snap the muzzle forward in a short closed-mouth strike, recover with delayed ears and tail tip
stationary: Paws and lower legs remain fixed. Accepted idle head, chest, ear, and tail mesh weights are reused.
